source: Five named stacks: ordered skills that compound on each other, with a cap on what the stack may claim a year so synergy multipliers cannot run past the line they act on (BRIEF §7.1).
confidenceNote: The groupings and the caps are choices, not findings.
note: skills in order; capCents is the most a stack is worth a year however the multipliers stack; capField names the household line the cap is really bounded by, when there is one. D-090.

stacks.name: The Kitchen
stacks.why: Three habits on the same two lines; the cap is the food you actually buy.

stacks.name: The Match
stacks.why: The plan, then one more point, then never touching it.

stacks.name: The Negotiator
stacks.why: Small asks practise the big one.

stacks.name: The Anchor
stacks.why: Worth nothing a year and everything in a bad one; the cap is zero because the value is risk, not dollars.

stacks.name: The Keeper
stacks.why: See it, rank it, cut it, keep it cut.
